verdict.rationale: Appwrite gives building blocks for leaving rather than a documented all-data export. These include open-source self-hosting with full control over data location, one-click migration from Appwrite Cloud to self-hosted, a dedicated native PostgreSQL option you can reach with psql, file download and list APIs, and a CLI that manages rows, files and users. Missing for 10: a unified export-all-data feature, documented open export formats (e.g., SQL dump, CSV or JSON for databases and auth users), outbound migration to non-Appwrite platforms, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete exit.
